summary: Tantech Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-50 reverse stock split of its class A common shares, approved by the board. Effective September 3, 2026, the split reduces outstanding shares from 33,382,332 to approximately 667,647, with no fractional shares. Shares will trade on Nasdaq under symbol TANH with a new CUSIP. Shareholders holding via brokers need no action. This routine corporate action is not a special situation, as it involves no acquisition, tender, restructuring, or strategic review. What to watch: potential Nasdaq compliance or liquidity effects post-split.
